title: Governed WordPress Staging deployment handoff v2

phases.objective: Expose a fail-closed, Site Profile-bound WordPress Staging exact-artifact deployment executor in the shared runtime while keeping Production execution authority absent and requiring live Staging certification before release acceptance.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Submit the exact reviewed WordPress HEAD to the Staging deployment endpoint with dry_run=true and no caller-selected target, path, host, credential, or artifact identifier.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The server resolves the unique governed ETG Staging Hostinger target, validates handoff v2 and exact artifact provenance, requires Site Profile identity before the first write, and keeps Production mutation unavailable.
steps: Resolve exactly one active and validated Hostinger target from server-owned remote runtime registration using ETG Staging environment, origin, Site UUID, and command allowlist.
Verify the successful exact-head WordPress General Distribution artifact, install manifest, MCP Adapter digest, build provenance, and deployment handoff v2.
Verify live WordPress environment, home/site URL, Site Profile UUID/origin/environment/revision/digest, and same-filesystem atomic replacement preconditions before any apply.
Require the explicit Staging apply feature gate, approval reason, and exact capability envelope before consequential execution.
On apply, back up the current Control Plane, atomically replace it, activate it, verify exact provenance and preserved Site Profile in the same cycle, and roll back on any mismatch.
Keep caller-selected targets, caller credentials, Raw SQL, Breakglass, File Manager side channels, implicit Production authority, and Production mutation unavailable.
assertions: The runtime deployment contract is mad4b.wordpress-staging-plugin-deploy.v2 and consumes mad4b.wordpress-deployment-handoff.v2.
The request schema does not expose target_id, app_path, host, SSH credentials/auth mode, artifact_id, Production, or Breakglass.
The server resolves a unique ETG Staging target and fails closed on zero or multiple matches.
The exact WordPress artifact and all embedded provenance digests are verified before first write.
Apply requires an exact capability envelope and same-cycle readback with automatic rollback on mismatch.
Production mutation remains false even though shared runtime files are deployed through both environment branches.
Live Staging certification remains required before this feature can be considered release-ready.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: After the Growth OS Staging execution plane contains this contract, run an exact-head dry-run against the enrolled ETG Staging Site Profile.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dry-run proves the exact server-resolved Hostinger target, WordPress artifact and Site Profile binding; a separately approved apply then deploys and proves exact same-cycle provenance without Production access.
steps: Run dry_run=true for the reviewed WordPress exact head without caller target or credential fields.
Require exact target, artifact, handoff, Site Profile and same-filesystem preflight evidence.
Create separate exact apply authority only after dry-run passes.

Execute the Staging-only atomic replacement and verify source commit, build fingerprint, package manifest digest, runtime manifest match, stale=false, zero provenance mismatches, and preserved Site Profile.
Verify Production was not accessed or mutated.
assertions: Live certification occurs only on Staging.
No Production deployment authority is reused or inferred.
The applied WordPress runtime matches the exact reviewed artifact.
Rollback occurs if exact readback does not match.
